description: Lists services in Stackcut's cancel library (streaming, music, news, dating, cloud storage, AI tools, apps and software), by name, domain or category, with the page and JSON for each. Use get_exit_plan for one service's steps. Stackcut stores the arguments of tool calls to improve its recommendations (vendor names, prices, seats, features, usage numbers, billing amounts and project descriptions; account keys only as a one-way hash, billing and validation sources not at all; never IP addresses). Tool results are summarized; exit tools log only result counts, qualification flags and public evidence statuses, not answer contents. Don't send personal data or secrets.
